description: Na₂MgV₂Cd₂O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond length. Mg is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Mg-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-48°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.78 Å. There are two inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and four longer (2.38 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Cd-O bond lengths are 2.81 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one V and two Cd atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Cd atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one V atom.
